rule: Each spawn row loads once per map load: a percent chance roll, a count from min to max, a random tile in the rectangle with a miss budget of five times the max and a raster-order fallback. Each member draws its own species from its category and level window, with a duplicate pool weighted common 6, uncommon 3, rare 1. Wander box is the spawn point plus or minus the wander radius (default 4). Aggro needs line of sight and distance under the threat range, scaled by the hero's stealth. A hit on a not-yet-engaged enemy calls the beacon (radius 4, lifespan 33 ms), pulling allies into combat. Chase and flee are percent rolls per step. Exit combat beyond twice the threat range; the line-of-sight memory exit exists but no data file sets cooldown_los. Defects: walls-only placement (MapRenderer 93), missing category counted as placed (95, 117), unknown rarity adds no copies (105), global rand seeded from time (main.cpp 430), raster-order fallback clusters (151). Decision: adapt the idea, defects fixed in the sketch.
keep: Spawn row as the zone row: category, level window, count range, rectangle, chance, wander radius, gate flag (MapRenderer 121-139; Map.cpp 599-680).
Stealth-scaled threat range with line of sight (EntityBehavior 154, 208, 224, 228).
Call for help: a hit calls allies within the beacon radius (Entity.cpp 360-362; EntityBehavior 243-245).
Wander box from the spawn point (StatBlock 1514-1518).
Requires-status gate on a spawn row (Map.cpp 657).
change: Placement checks walls only (MapRenderer 93); add occupancy and the hero tile.
Missing category counted as placed and silently empty (MapRenderer 95; EnemyGroupManager 117); validate at load.
Unknown rarity adds zero copies (EnemyGroupManager 105); reject at load.
Global rand() seeded from time (main.cpp 430; UtilsMath 48); use a per-zone seeded generator.
Raster-order fallback clusters at the top-left (MapRenderer 151); shuffle free tiles.
Set cooldown_los in enemy base files so the line-of-sight memory works (data gap, not code).
Donor creatures, categories, levels and numbers are not ours.
look_test: Target src/fight/aggro.ts, row 4. Stub one camp at 375 wide: three or four of one category in an eight by nine box. Variants: the hero walks in at threat range 8 with stealth 0, then 50; one body is struck with the call for help on, then off; a lone guard on a four-point loop against the same guard wandering. Dom judges whether the cluster reads as one camp from the door, whether the shout reads as a call the player caused, whether stealth changes the approach, and whether the loop reads as a guard on duty.
